_about: Master list of every media team task. Edit this file to add, remove, or reword items. 'automation' marks what could be handed to a script or AI later: manual = a person must do it, assist = AI could help or double-check, auto = could be fully automated.

checklists.title: Thursday Prep
checklists.summary: Get everything for Sunday into ProPresenter and set up the live streams, so Sunday is just pressing buttons.

items.title: Get the song list for Sunday
items.details: Get the songs, the order they'll be sung in, and the song arrangement (verse/chorus order) from the worship leader.

items.title: Get the sermon slides and scripture references
items.details: Get the sermon title, slides (if any), and every scripture reference and Bible translation the pastor will use.

items.title: Get this week's announcements
items.details: Get the announcement slides or text, plus any videos or special items (baby dedication, baptism, guest speaker).

items.title: Upload lyrics for every song
items.details: Check the ProPresenter Library first. If a song is already there, reuse it. If not, import or type the lyrics.

items.title: Check lyrics for spelling, line breaks, and arrangement
items.details: Every slide easy to read (2 to 4 lines), no typos, sections in the same order the band will play them.

items.title: Verify keys
items.details: Confirm the key and arrangement of each song with the worship leader, so everything on the screens matches what the band plays.

items.title: Upload the sermon slides
items.details: Import the pastor's slides into ProPresenter and check each one shows correctly on the screens.

items.title: Add scripture slides
items.details: Add every scripture reference in the translation the pastor uses. Double-check the reference numbers.

items.title: Add announcements and countdown
items.details: Add the announcement slides and the pre-service countdown timer.

items.title: Build Sunday's playlist in order of service
items.details: Make a new playlist named with Sunday's date (for example 2026-10-25 Sunday). Put everything in the order it will happen: countdown, welcome, songs, announcements, sermon, closing.

items.title: Make sure everything the live stream needs is in ProPresenter
items.details: Check the items the live stream viewers will see: sermon title, scripture, lower thirds (names on screen), and the end-of-stream slide.

items.title: Click through the whole playlist once
items.details: Go through every slide from start to finish. Look for typos, blank slides, missing media, and anything out of order.

items.title: Set up the YouTube stream: title, description, thumbnail
items.details: Use the standard title format (see the YouTube page). Add the sermon title, the pastor's name, and the date.

items.title: Set up the Facebook stream: title and description
items.details: Use the same title and description as YouTube.

items.title: Check that YouTube and Facebook are still connected in Streamlabs
items.details: Click Go Live in Streamlabs and make sure the church YouTube channel and Facebook page are both listed and switched on. Close the window without going live.

items.title: Enter the stream information in Streamlabs
items.details: In Streamlabs, put the title and description for each platform (YouTube and Facebook) so they're ready on Sunday.

checklists.title: Sunday Service
checklists.summary: Set up, run worship lyrics, go live when worship ends, then wrap up.

items.title: Turn on the MacBook, screens, and projectors/TVs
items.details: Plug in the MacBook's charger. Turn on Do Not Disturb so pop-up notifications don't show on the screens.

items.title: Open ProPresenter and load today's playlist
items.details: Check the playlist has today's date. If you can't find it, check with whoever did Thursday prep.

items.title: Check that the audience and stage screens are showing correctly
items.details: Put a slide up and check it on every screen, including the stage screen the band sees.

items.title: Confirm everything for the live stream is in ProPresenter
items.details: Check the sermon slides, scripture, lower thirds, and end slide are all in today's playlist. If anything was added after Thursday, add it now.

items.title: Open Streamlabs and check the scenes
items.details: Click through each scene (before stream, camera, slides, end) and make sure the camera and slides show up.

items.title: Check the stream audio levels
items.details: Watch the Streamlabs audio mixer while the band sound checks. Levels should move, but never stay in the red.

items.title: Double-check the stream titles and descriptions
items.details: Make sure YouTube and Facebook both have today's title, not last week's.

items.title: Check the internet connection
items.details: Make sure the MacBook is on the church network (wired if possible). Load YouTube to confirm it works.

items.title: Run the countdown before service
items.details: Start the countdown in ProPresenter so it ends right when service starts.

items.title: Run the lyrics for each song
items.details: Stay one step ahead of the singers. Change the slide right before the first word of the next line. Remember: we do NOT go live yet.

items.title: Click Go Live in Streamlabs when worship ends
items.details: Wait for worship to fully end, then click Go Live. Make sure both YouTube and Facebook are turned on before you confirm.

items.title: Confirm the stream is live on YouTube and Facebook
items.details: Check from a phone. Make sure you can see and hear the stream on both platforms.

items.title: Run the sermon slides and scripture
items.details: Follow the pastor. Switch Streamlabs scenes when slides or scripture should show on the stream.

items.title: Keep an eye on the stream
items.details: Every few minutes, check the Streamlabs status bar for dropped frames, and check that audio is still moving.

items.title: Switch to the end scene, then click End Stream
items.details: Leave the end slide up for about 30 seconds before ending the stream.

items.title: Confirm the video saved on YouTube and Facebook
items.details: Check that the recording shows up on the church channel and page.

items.title: Clear the screens, close the apps, turn off the screens
items.details: Clear everything in ProPresenter, close Streamlabs, and turn off the projectors/TVs.

items.title: Write down anything that went wrong
items.details: Use the notes box on any item that had a problem so we can fix it before next week.
